newsitem.title: GERMANY: German non-banks sold money mkt funds in Aug - Buba.
newsitem.headline: German non-banks sold money mkt funds in Aug - Buba.

text.p: German non-banks sold a net one billion marks in money market funds in August, continuing a trend of the previous five months, the Bundesbank said on Thursday.

In a statement on money supply growth the Bundesbank said domestic money market funds had at the same time increased their deposits at domestic banks by 200 million marks and reduced their deposits at German banks' foreign units by 500 million.
Non-bank money market fund investments are not included in the headline M3 money supply figure, but in the Bundesbank's so-called "expanded M3", which has only been calculated through July.
Expanded M3 rose 6.5 percent from February though July, somewhat slower than regular M3 which grew at an annualised rate of 8.7 percent in August, the Bundesbank said.
